## Billing
### Payment history
The **Payment history** card on the org billing page lists your recent credit top-ups. Each row shows:
| Column | Details |
| Date | When the top-up was processed |
| Amount | Amount charged in USD |
| Status | `Succeeded`, `Pending`, or `Failed` |
| Receipt | Link to the Stripe-hosted receipt (opens in a new tab) |
If a receipt isn't available yet the cell shows **Processing** (for pending charges) or **Not available** (for succeeded charges w
ithout a receipt link).
To add credits, click **Top up** — either from the empty state when you have no history, or from the credit balance card above.
> [!NOTE]
> **Free plan organizations cannot purchase credits directly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog shows
a message that only an organization owner can upgrade the plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog and
opens your organization's Plans settings so you can upgrade.
> [!NOTE]
> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in the desktop app, checkout opens in your default system browser and the dialog clos
es automatically. Your credit balance updates in the app once the purchase completes — no redirect back into the app is required.
### Spend budget
### Pre-run credit estimate
When enabled on your account, an **ⓘ** icon appears beside run controls before you launch. Hovering it shows an estimated credit c
ost for the run about to start — priced against the exact models, cases, and iteration count the button will execute.
The estimate appears on:
* **Run all** in the suite header — prices every case × model × iterations × run plans.
* **Per-case Run** buttons in the cases list and case sidebar — prices that case's configured models for one quick run.
* **Run / Run compare** in the template editor — prices the currently selected models and the current (possibly unsaved) prompt.
* **Swarm journey cards** — prices the journey's next run across its live targets.
The tooltip shows a headline figure and a per-model or per-component breakdown. Copy varies by how well-grounded the estimate is:
| Copy | Meaning |
| Estimated: \~N credits — based on your recent runs | Full coverage, grounded in your own run history |
| Estimated: \~N credits — partly based on recent runs | Full coverage, partially grounded in history |
| Rough estimate: \~N credits — improves after first run | Full coverage, heuristic only (no history yet) |
| At least \~N credits — part of this run is unpriced | Some models or run slices could not be priced |
| Estimate unavailable for these models | No pricing data available |
1 credit = \$0.01. Your free daily allowance and any BYOK keys change what is actually deducted. The estimate is informational onl
y — it never blocks or gates a run.
